description: This file defines the OTAConfiguration class used to configure and initiate OTA package generation, including methods for sending forms, chain forms, and resetting flags. It also exports flag configurations for OTA options.

classes.name: OTAConfiguration
classes.description: Class for configuring OTA package generation, including methods to send forms, chain forms, and reset flags.

methods.name: sendForms
methods.description: Generates OTA packages between target builds and incremental sources, handling incremental and full OTA logic.

methods.name: sendChainForms
methods.description: Generates OTA packages between a sequence of target builds in order.

methods.name: sendForm
methods.description: Starts an OTA package generation from a target build to an incremental source, returning backend message.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all flags in the OTAConfiguration object.
